thread:
Elaine K.: quick sync — were running a weekend tease for Tue webinar. Need X + LinkedIn + a short gif + a DM seedlist. Who can own which piece?
Samir: Ill take X threads. Will draft 2 hooks + 1 CTA variant (replay vs benchmarks).
Maria: I can do LinkedIn long-form post + a 4-slide carousel idea. Need 3 concise benchmark bullets and a hero image.
Jordan: Design can do a 5s looping GIF and two banner sizes. ETA Mon 9am PT.
Taylor: Ill own seedlist routing and SDR handoff. Please send CSV and final UTMs by Mon 11am.
Elaine K.: timeline: Sat 11am PT — short X tease (thread + gif). Mon 9am PT — LinkedIn main push + carousel. Tue 8am PT — reminder thread + webinar link.
Samir: X thread skeleton: `1/ Quick hook on inference economics -> 2/ three bullets (latency, cost, deploy) -> 3/ customer snippet -> 4/ CTA + replay link`. A/B CTA test: `Watch replay` vs `See performance`.
Maria: carousel idea: slide1 hero, slide2 benchmarks, slide3 deployment modes, slide4 CTA + signup. Also propose pin a comment with timestamped highlights.
Jordan: tagging @Design  please prioritize the 5s GIF in 16:9 and a 1:1 square for X. Deliver PNG + MP4.
Design: got it — starting now. Mockups by Sun EOD, final assets Mon morning.
Taylor: routing plan: seedlist -> SDR queue tag `webinar-nurture`. Cadence: DM initial invite, 24h follow-up, final reminder with replay. Ill create the Trello card for SDRs.
Samir: can we also pin an engagement experiment — thread with a question prompt vs statement? to measure CTR.
Elaine K.: yes — experiment = CTA wording + prompt vs statement. Keep variants small. Samir, include tracking params: `utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=webinar_mar24&utm_content=variantA`
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled posts require assets 12h before slot. Use `/schedule` to reserve posting windows.
Maria: Hey—also can we surface one quick quote from the keynote for the carousel? @Product might have something.
Elaine K.: will pull a quote and drop in #product.
Jordan: noted — will build GIF to accommodate quote overlay.
Taylor: once seedlist is uploaded Ill map owners and add follow-up templates.
Samir: Ill drop drafts in this thread by Sat 6pm PT.
Elaine K.: perfect — thanks team. "
